status: independent static review; prior LOCV2 findings cleared in the reviewed source; no execution, imports, compilation, package edits, or empirical claims

reviewed_and_withdrawn.claim: fractional strict close invalidation is off by one
reviewed_and_withdrawn.reason: _thresholds returns (floor, ceil); the kernel assigns tf= floor(upper+distance), bc= floor(lower-distance), then uses close > tf and close < bc, which are the correct strict integer comparisons.

reviewed_and_withdrawn.claim: episode reset requires an additional one-tick close clearance
reviewed_and_withdrawn.reason: The governing frozen semantics require two wholly outside observed bars. new_episode uses the two-bar gap rule; no additional clearance requirement is established by the supplied correction cases.

reviewed_and_withdrawn.claim: contact timing metadata claims a definite bar end while code stores an index
reviewed_and_withdrawn.reason: Current metadata explicitly describes minute indexes as label intervals and separates endpoint, maturity, and prefix maturity. Additional timestamp fields could improve downstream use but are not a current defect established by this review.

resolved_findings.prior_claim: Derived mirror and snap candidates could be available before their causal anchor was known.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current derived definitions set available_at_ns to the maximum of the source candidate availability and anchor_known_at (line 106), and lineage retains anchor_known_at_ns (line 149).
resolved_findings.evidence: The derived availability is causal with respect to the anchor dependency; no stale formation-only availability path remains in this source.

resolved_findings.prior_claim: A fallback formation-close anchor could be accepted without a causal formation end or cut guard.
resolved_findings.resolution: The formation-close anchor branch now requires formation_end_ns and available_at_ns, and enforces formation_end_ns <= available_at_ns <= min(origin, evaluation_cut) (lines 68-74). Anchor-dependent definitions require a non-null anchor.
resolved_findings.evidence: Malformed, future-dated, or publication-unknown formation closes cannot enter the valid derived geometry path in this source.

resolved_findings.prior_claim: Unversioned source identities and malformed dates could pass year-shard admission.
resolved_findings.resolution: _validate_rows now requires a nonempty series and row source_version, exact ISO date parsing/canonical round-trip, and exact root/year agreement (lines 161-181).
resolved_findings.evidence: None==None source admission and four-character date-prefix admission are no longer available in the reviewed path.

resolved_findings.prior_claim: Preflight could project from mixed or unadmitted rows because validation occurred only after date selection.
resolved_findings.resolution: preflight_location_year validates the complete rows input before selecting the six dates (lines 263-265), then records full_formation_count from that admitted population (lines 279-284).
resolved_findings.evidence: Mixed-root/year/source/date rows are rejected before the selected-date extraction and cost projection.

resolved_findings.prior_claim: An oversized Fraction departure ratio could bypass the int64 configuration bound.
resolved_findings.resolution: _configuration applies positive int64 numerator and denominator bounds to Fraction values as well as tuple/int inputs (lines 38-50).
resolved_findings.evidence: The plan cannot retain the previously identified out-of-domain rational ratio.
